newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - August 4.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - August 4.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Monday:
* Shares are likely to drift between 2,600 and 2,700 points on the back of an edgy currency market and the release of more company earnings, traders said.

* Anscor-Hagedorn Securities said in its outlook the market will also watch out for the release of July inflation figures within the week as well as the first six months' gross national product (GNP) data by the end of the month.
